definitions.explanation: An elevated, literary term for a pleasant, noticeable fragrance. Often used to describe the aroma of flowers, tea, wine, or food in refined or written contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{香気|こうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: The fragrance of flowers drifts through the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な{香気|こうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}っている→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧。
examples.english: This wine gives off a rich aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶室|ちゃしつ}→茶室：14081_chashitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{香気|こうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちていた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧。
examples.english: Upon entering the tea room, the aroma of matcha filled the entire space.

notes:
A literary compound of ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧ (fragrance) + ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (air/spirit). More elevated than everyday words for smell; primarily found in written language and formal descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {香気|こうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧: fragrance drifts/wafts
- {香気|こうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧: to give off fragrance
- ⟦{芳醇|ほうじゅん}→芳醇：08200_houjun⟧な{香気|こうき}: a mellow, rich aroma
- {香気|こうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: to be filled with fragrance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: scent, fragrance — the most common everyday word for pleasant smell
- ⟦{芳香|ほうこう}→芳香：13960_houkou⟧: sweet fragrance — literary, similar level of formality
- ⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧: smell, scent — neutral; can be pleasant or unpleasant
- アロマ: aroma — modern loanword, especially for aromatherapy
